integrationReview.storage: Only the previously reviewed talents object/array type guard and optional finite nonnegative roll multiplier metadata checks differ from input. Main/mirror/archive/expected-snapshot order and keys remain untouched.
integrationReview.actionFocus: The helper stores runId/generation in an ephemeral closure and reads/focuses DOM elements. It has no storage/RNG/asset interface. app integration remains after committed transactions, cancels on dialog/run/storage changes, and does not edit game snapshots.
integrationReview.encounterTactics: A read-only public enemy/count projection; it calls the pure deepEnemyAttack helper for two attack multipliers. It has no saved RNG, storage API or transition call; it does not write to enemy.
integrationReview.combinedCompatibility: No additional state or metadata is serialized by focus/tactics. The only intentional new saved fields remain lastRoll.criticalMultiplier and lastRoll.followMultiplier. Related branches keep old missing fields legal.
integrationReview.sameNameExtensionLimit: External old files with these two previously unknown names holding nonnumeric values are now rejected; unrelated unknown fields remain preserved.
integrationReview.appOnlyFollowup: These two audit scripts do not import src/app.js. A later app-only summary keyboard fix does not change the modules exercised by these gates; its native-browser input behavior needs separate verification.

limits: Closure is a synthetic room/event/shop state audit with in-memory fault injection, not a count of independent players or natural playthroughs.
The 41,452 checks, 6,476 snapshots and 1,811 transactions overlap; they are separate measures, not additive sample counts.
The size gate uses constructed extension-field fixtures and an in-memory store, not actual browser quota or file-picker evidence.
Closure does not roll through entire event-created combats; the optional multipliers have separate independently recorded battle coverage.
No physical power loss, actual OS suspension, native browser quota, real mobile device or Windows launcher was verified here.
This final execution is against current 5.8.0 only; no fresh baseline run or final ZIP extraction is claimed.
